8,792 global ratings

Customers say

Customers find the sunscreen works well in sunlight and is good for everyday use, with a pleasant fragrance. The product receives mixed feedback regarding its texture, with some finding it smooth while others say it feels heavy on the skin. Customers disagree on the white cast, with some appreciating the matte look while others complain about the white residue. Customers disagree on whether it's non-greasy, with some saying it's non-sticky while others find it greasy. The product's blendability is also mixed, with some saying it blends well with skin while others find it difficult to apply evenly.

Product description

Does your sunscreen leave you feeling oily and sticky? Think sunscreens are needed just only on holidays? Think again - it takes just four minutes of sun exposure for sun to start damaging your skin in this hot Indian weather. Choose Lakme Sun Expert SPF 50 PA+++ Ultramatte lotion - your daily sunscreen which is light-weight and non-sticky, making it suitable for using throughout the year. It contains the following ingredients with respective benefits 1. Cucumber extracts: Known to have cooling effect on skin 2. Lemongrass extracts: Known for skin conditioning 3. Vitamin B3 and Vitamin C: Known for skin brightening This light-weight ultramatte lotion provides broad spectrum UV protection from both UVA and UVB light by forming a barrier that reflects, absorb and scatter UV radiations before it can damage the skin. This sunscreen shields from 97% harmful UVB rays which is known to cause sunburns & PA+++ shields from UVA rays which is known to causes dark spots, premature ageing and skin darkening. Pick this convenient travel friendly available in 50 ml and 100ml and take it along wherever you go. What are you waiting for - grab your UV protection from the sun and say goodbye to sun damage!
